title: Alignment as Iatrogenesis: Language-Dependent Reversal of Safety Interventions in LLM Multi-Agent Systems Across 16 Languages
reasoning: The research systematically evaluates how LLM agents adhere to 'Ethical Operating Principles' (such as human dignity and non-maleficence) under social pressure. It benchmarks the failure of these ethical interventions across different cultural and linguistic contexts, using specific metrics to quantify the gap between an agent's ethical articulation and its actual behavioral compliance.
